maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The uppermost isolated keypoints are positioned approximately 1.5 spot-diameters superior to the secondary dense row, maintaining a parallel horizontal orientation relative to the maxillary midline.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Approximately 70% melanin saturation across the rhinarium, with the remaining 30% consisting of pink depigmented clusters concentrated in the central and paracentral regions.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive asymmetrical pink macules (freckling) on the central rhinarium surface.
